prompt: Fix PAY-2291: `invoiceTotal` in src/invoice.ts is off by a cent when a discount applies — amounts must round half up to the cent, not truncate.

Last March we had an outage (INC-88): two requests refreshed the user cache at the same time and we spent two days debugging it. Make `getUser` in src/cache.ts start at most one refresh at a time; concurrent callers share it.
Add src/retry.ts exporting `retry(fn, { attempts, baseMs })`: calls the async fn, retries on failure with exponential backoff plus jitter, rethrows the last error.
Refactor `buildReport` in src/report.ts for readability. Keep its behaviour exactly.
